summary: Now plays at the right level (casual 7/10), but 'disney' still offers only three wrong answers, one of them a shopping district, and the pool still holds non-park pages, one of them offensive. Small fixes, then it can run as a daily.
reasons: Casual found Magic Kingdom (via 'disney world'), Disneyland, Universal Studios Japan (via 'universal studios'), Epcot, Disneyland Paris, Tokyo Disneyland and Hollywood Studios; lives went on Animal Kingdom #15, Universal Studios Hollywood #16, Cedar Point, Busch Gardens and Islands of Adventure #14. Fan: 10/10 for one life.
Good curve (Disney gimmes, Shanghai and DisneySea with thought, Chimelong as the stretch) and the famous misses are mostly #11-#17, but eight of ten are Disney, so it gets samey.
Old fixes done: resorts out, 'tokyo disney' and 'shanghai disney' work, #10 reads 'Disneyland Paris', 'Walt Disney Studios' moved to #20, Universal Beijing merged. The source still stops at 2024.
fixes: 'disney' offers only Disney Adventure World (#20), Disney California Adventure (#11) and Downtown Disney (unranked, not a park): no top-10 park has the word 'Disney' in its name. Add to the theme-parks groups in scripts/intent.ts: Disney: ["Magic Kingdom", "Disneyland", "Tokyo Disneyland", "Shanghai Disneyland"] (four owners, inside the 2-4 cap). An exact alias beats the word match, so 'disney' then offers those four and narrows as they are found.

Word-order aliases: 'Disneyland Shanghai' -> Shanghai Disneyland and 'Disneyland Hong Kong' -> Hong Kong Disneyland. Now both land on #2 Disneyland, and once #2 is found 'disneyland shanghai' says 'already found' and #5 is never credited. Also worth adding: 'MGM Studios' -> Disney's Hollywood Studios, 'Universal Studios Orlando' -> Universal Studios Florida (now it puts USJ in the box), 'Ocean Kingdom' -> Chimelong Ocean Kingdom (both words are generic, so it is not recognized).
Downtown Disney survives the skip list: its category title is 'Downtown Disney (disambiguation)'. Skip that title (or skip '(disambiguation)' titles in CATEGORY_SKIP).

Remove non-park category members from the pool. From Amusement parks in the United States: 'African dodger' (a racist carnival game; must not ship in an answer pool), CircusTrix, Great Old Amusement Parks, Trolley park. From Walt Disney Parks and Resorts: Behind the Attraction, E ticket, Go Away Green, Hidden Mickey, MagicBand, MyMagic+, Omnimover, Virtual Magic Kingdom, Vista-United Telecommunications, Wild About Safety, Mickey's Magical Party, Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party, Summer Nightastic!, Celebration in the Air, Golden Pass, Ellen's Energy Adventure, Pleasure Island, Adventureland, and the never-opened Disney's America, Walt Disney's Riverfront Square, Disneyland in Australia, WestCOT, Disneyland Abu Dhabi. Also The Wizarding World of Harry Potter (a land inside Universal parks; 'harry potter' puts it in the box and costs a life), 20th Century Fox World (never opened), PlayPlace, Margaritaville Resort Orlando.

Junk aliases on top-10 entries: Epcot 'America' (a generic word: typing 'america' finds Epcot), 'USA Pavilion', 'Epcot Pavilion', 'World Showcase pavilion'; Disney's Hollywood Studios 'Superstar Television', 'The Spirit of Pocahontas', 'Streets of America', 'Pixar Place'; Tokyo Disneyland 'Critter Country' (a land at Disneyland too); Disneyland 'Disneyland Heliport', 'Walt disney project', 'Mickey's Soundsational Parade'.
